site_findings.title: Sitemap served with X-Robots-Tag: noindex
site_findings.fix: Remove noindex from the sitemap response before a Search Console upload. Google can fetch a noindexed sitemap, but every listed URL that also sends noindex will be discovered and then excluded. Flip the header on the sitemap and on the pages you want indexed in the same change.
